d:
Luka Dončić put up a statline the NBA has never seen, finishing with 45 points, 15 rebounds, 6 assists, 5 steals and 8 threes against the Raptors!
He became the first player in NBA history to record 45+ points, 15+ rebounds, 5+ assists, 5+ steals and 5+ three-pointers in a game. Even without the points requirement, he’s still the first player ever with 15+ rebounds, 5+ assists, 5+ steals and 5+ threes in a game.
